meta.title: Counter Offer button opens the counter offer interface

plan.title: Counter Offer interface opens for vendor quote

steps.note: Open the eRFX event creation screen.
Configure the event as an RFQ so the counter-offer action is available on the pricing round.
Apply the first available RFQ pricing template.
Add a product for the vendor to quote.
Commit a bidding schedule so the RFQ can be published.
Invite one QA vendor to provide the required quote.
Confirm the event reached a real published project page.
Submit a vendor quote so the buyer has a bid to counter.
Confirm the vendor quote was accepted.
Open the buyer comparison view where the vendor's Counter Offer control is available.
Open the vendor's Counter Offer interface, enter a revised price, and send it.
Confirm the buyer view records that the counter offer was initiated for the vendor.
